text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Racecourse was shaking at the close of the year.
Split right down the middle by deafening cheers—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooooah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vistaaaaa!!
Go get 'eeeeeem!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
My heart is so full... but,
I won't cry!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen... this year, for sure...!
I'll live up to everyone's expectations—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
From the magnificent view of victory!
Let us shed tears together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First is Buena Vista. She has announced that this race
will be her last before retiring from the front lines.
Her popularity is staggering—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the pre-race fan poll,
Orfevre came in second... behind Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
In other words...
you claim I would lose to the likes of her?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fan voting doesn't just reflect pure expectations of ability.
It also carries strong emotional weight, like popularity
and cheering support for that Umamusume.
choice_data_list: It's proof of how much Buena Vista is loved.
It's proof of how loved Buena Vista is, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Rather than inevitability,
do you wish for a dramatic miracle?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
That is precisely why the role given to that one will shine.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It will serve as a fitting wake-up call
for the foolish masses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――Another cheer divides Nakayama Racecourse.
Orfevre, now a Triple Crown horse girl, was receiving
support just as fierce as Buena Vista's.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfeeeeeevre!!
Lady Orfeeeeevre~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Hear me, my people.
Do not slacken."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Is this the extent
of your loyalty?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
...!
L-Lady Orfevre~~~~~~!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vistaaaaaaa!!
OrfeeeeeeÃ¨vre~~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeek... What in the world is with this heat...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It feels a bit unusual today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even frontline Senior Class veterans like Tosen Jordan and Eishin Flash flinched in the face of the fierce intensity burning there.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel the swell of a new era.
Today marks an end, and a beginning..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If there's ever a time to show your grit,
it's right now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...A-All right!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Orfe-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a great race today!
It's an honor... to face you as you are now.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: How cruel.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Your graceful trajectory
shall be trampled beneath the king.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine!
I'm actually super grateful, you know."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because defeating someone as radiant as you
would make for the ultimate illumination, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I shall reassign you your role.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
O fair and valiant Queen.
Thank you for your reign up to this day.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I will make you a thing of the past.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Scatter, and do so gloriously.
To mark the dawn of a new era.
